text_block_list.name: Referee Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let the Neighborhood Big Baseball Tournament begin!!
—Play ball!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Since we're doing this, let's give it our all.
Let us aim for the very top.
Just a moment ago, on the way back from going out with Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Found yaaaaa! Verxina,
you're the final piece of the puzzle!!" his

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on♪ Let's head to Koshien♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I somehow got dragged into this
without even realizing it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me...
Thank you so much for the help!!
Thanks to you, we'll be able to hold the match!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no. It's really nothing you need to thank me for yet...

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all! We're always short on people, so we can't even play matches!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Today, I can finally race, I can finally compete...
That alone is more than enough! Hoping to actually win
might be a bit too presumptuous of me, or something—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Is just being able to compete enough?
Are you not aiming for the top?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(—No.
No, the path I shall show as Queen is—!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, please do not be so faint-hearted. Let us win today.

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I appreciate the thought, but...
our opponents are a powerhouse team that's even won tournaments...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even so! No matter what happens—
You must aim for the summit.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Looking at everyone... seeing the blisters and
calluses on those hands, I can tell.
You must have put in effort day after day, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, you must aim for results worthy of it.
Above all, you should strive with all your might for results
you can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Is something amiss?

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san...
...Haha, incredible!!
I feel like my eyes have been opened...!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
All right, we're going for the win!!
Let's get fired up, everyone--!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Pop fly!
Pitcher, catch it, catch it...!"
(Thud—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't sweat it, don't sweat it!
Let's switch gears and move forward!!
(*CLANG!*)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh!! Nice hit!
Run, run!!

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text:
"Oooohhh!! Here's the chance, the chance!"
"Hang in there! Make it, make it in time...!!"

text_block_list.name: Referee Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And home iiiin!!
That's one run-!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yaaaaaayyyy!!!
Let's keep this momentum going and aim for a comeback victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text:
"Oooohhh!! I got it, I got it—!"
"Keep this momentum going, let's do this—!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sayonara, adieu, bye-nara!!
And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Just as expected of a powerhouse! It's the other side of the river team~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up losing by a hair, but...
thanks to you, it was a truly fulfilling match!
Thank you very much, Verxina-san."

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We will…… keep doing our best to reach the top.
Engraving your words of encouragement today into our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
! ...Fufu.
That would be quite an honor.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I'm so glad I chose to walk this path.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The crown I ought to strive for...
lies just beyond the path
that so many people look up to..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Such brilliance truly exists.
I can now strongly believe that."
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll make a wonderful queen.
I'm sure you'll make a wonderful queen.
Are you going to play baseball again?
I'd love to play catch with you sometime.

text_block_list.text:

I can now strongly believe that."
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll make a wonderful queen.
I'm sure you'll make a wonderful queen.
Are you going to play baseball again?
I'd love to play catch with you sometime.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Of course.
I promise you that I will definitely show you that sight."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still... being a "Captain" like today
might not be so bad once in a while, would it? Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If the opportunity arises,
perhaps I shall chase after the ball once more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a sport I've been familiar with for a very long time...
I have so many fond memories of playing it with my little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Let's do it, by all means.
It'll be a nice change of pace, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, go ahead and throw with all your might.
I will catch whatever comes my way.
